text.card: A red giant 1,028 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.64 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,838 K at its surface.
